question.text: A PM believes her stock-picking ability is better than average and concentrates the portfolio. This is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Overconfidence = overestimating own skill/knowledge; leads to excessive concentration, turnover, under-diversification. The Trap: Regret aversion is opposite — avoiding action due to fear of regret. Cross-Exam Context: Behavioural canon. Manager's Pro-Tip: Track hit-rate of trades honestly — reality-check overconfidence via IC measurement (Grinold-Kahn).
